summary:
Challenge 2026 under the category **“Be An Earth System Trend Detective!”**

The project aims to help users explore and understand changes in Earth's environmental systems using NASA satellite imagery, climate data and natural-event records. By entering geographical coordinates, users can investigate different locations around the world and examine environmental conditions such as temperature, humidity, wind speed and direction, rainfall, cloud cover and solar energy.

EarthScope uses NASA POWER data to display environmental measurements and visualize recent daily temperature and precipitation patterns. It also integrates NASA GIBS satellite imagery, including MODIS vegetation imagery and SMAP soil-moisture layers, allowing users to explore Earth's surface from different perspectives. NASA EONET provides information about recorded natural events, such as wildfires, storms and volcanic activity.

The platform combines these different sources of Earth observation data into one interactive dashboard, helping users connect environmental measurements with geographical information. It also provides simple, understandable observations based on the returned data to encourage users to investigate environmental conditions further.
